title: Al Safi
summary: A series of short-form AI-generated advertisements created for Al Safi, designed for fast-paced digital and social media use.
description:
A series of short-form AI-generated advertisements created for Al Safi, designed for fast-paced digital and social media use.

I developed the project end-to-end, covering concept development, creative direction, visual development, AI production, editing, post-production, and final delivery.

Each video was built from the ground up using an AI-driven production workflow, with a focus on strong product presentation, cinematic visuals, and concise 15–20 second storytelling.
